replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
The terrain looks, kinda bland and not very much block variations as i just see green and grey.
I would also intend on making some structures, like towers and gates so it would make the gameplay more interesting.
But, anyways. Good work on the map!

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Looks rather empty, too flat also, needs more structures, and the size is really small for both TDM and DTM.

Try expanding it up a bit, adding more structures, perhaps a bit more detail in the outer part of the map (because the spawns look really good!) and improve the terrain, make it less flat.
Thanks!
